artworks.title: La Petite Marine - Souvenir de Medway
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, aquatint, and roulette in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays a seascape with a sailing vessel positioned towards the left side of the picture, moving across choppy waters. The horizon line is below the midpoint, meeting a sky filled with dynamic clouds. The sky is characterized by varied brushstrokes conveying movement and texture. The color scheme is predominantly sepia. A small figure is seen sitting on a wooden structure in the foreground. Wooden posts and piles of stones are scattered around the coastal setting. In the distance, vague structures hint at nautical elements like lighthouses. The overall mood is dramatic, emphasizing the interaction between the sea and sky.

artworks.title: Les Voisins de Campagne (Country Neighbors)
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, and drypoint in black on cream laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a pathway leading to a grand house. The viewpoint is slightly elevated. The horizon is subtly defined by the roofline of the house and the tree tops. The color palette is monochromatic with sepia tones. The brushstrokes are detailed, especially around the figures and foliage. Two figures walk arm in arm with a dog under an umbrella. In the distance, a large house is surrounded by trees and a white fence.

artworks.title: Ex-Libris pour "L'Ensorcelée" (Bookplate for "L'Ensorcelée")
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and aquatint in black-brown on cream laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays flowing and curved lines, forming an arch at the top center. In the artwork, intricate details mimic objects such as a winged figure or angel, two statuesque forms resembling human figures, and a swan-like bird gliding across a water surface. Wispy lines in the background and foreground create depth, with elements that could resemble foliage blending into the corners of the piece.

artworks.title: Les Petites Chaumières (Thatched Cottages--Small Plate)
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: This image depicts a rural scene with a group of geese walking in a farmyard. A small pond is to the right and a thatched roof house is in the background with smoke coming from the chimney. The sky has swirling clouds and the color palette is primarily earthy brown tones. Shadow and light are used to add depth to the image.

artworks.title: Les Noctambules (The Night Prowlers)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint with scraping and burnishing in black on light blue laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a dark, cobblestone street scene with dogs gathered around a figure holding an umbrella. The composition is centered on a silhouetted figure under a large umbrella, surrounded by a pack of darkly rendered dogs. The street they stand upon is textured with cobblestones. The background is a shadowy space with indications of buildings or structures. The play of light and shadow, along with textured lines, creates a moody atmosphere.

artworks.title: Un Débarquement en Angleterre (Landing in England)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, aquatint (dust ground and spirit ground), roulette, and burnishing in black on oatmeal paper
artworks.description: The image shows a dock scene during a stormy evening. The perspective is slightly elevated, capturing a view of the bustling dock with tall masts and flagpoles against a turbulent sky. The style features intricate line work, conveying movement and atmosphere. The color palette is somber and moody, with deep grays and blacks dominating the scene. Figures with umbrellas walk along the wet pier, with a dog nearby. In the distance, other figures and structures fade into the darkness.

artworks.title: Le Petit Enterrement (The Burial - Small Plate)
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a rainy street scene with numerous umbrellas. The drawing shows a silhouette-filled street with figures holding umbrellas as rain falls. The background depicts a crowd moving towards a light source. The foreground figures are larger and more pronounced, with intricate cross-hatching enhancing the texture and movement. The composition uses strong contrasts between light and dark, capturing the essence of a rainy night.

artworks.title: La Ronde de Nuit (Night Patrol)
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, and drypoint in black on moderately thick beige laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a path receding into the distance, with a figure walking with an umbrella. Dark, shadowy forms dominate the composition, with lighter patches suggesting puddles. Expressive brushstrokes create swirling patterns in the sky and trees. The color palette is monochromatic, with sepia tones and highlights creating contrast. Silhouettes of structures and trees are faintly outlined in the distance.

artworks.title: Liseuse à la Lampe (Woman Reading by Lamplight)
artworks.medium: etching with scraping and burnishing in black on thin tissue paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated in a chair, reading a book by the light of an oil lamp. She is leaning slightly forward, with most of her body visible. She is wearing a long-sleeved dress and her hair is styled up or back. The woman's facial features are softly illuminated by the lamp placed on a nearby table. The chair, table, and lamp have classic designs. The scene is set in a cozy interior with warm lighting, and shadowy outlines of furniture and architectural elements can be seen in the background.

artworks.title: Un Grain à Trouville (Squall at Trouville)
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: The image displays a beach scene with people carrying umbrellas. The figures are drawn in a delicate style, wearing period clothing. The sky is dynamic with moving clouds, and the sea stretches into the distance with faint boats visible. The artist used fine etching techniques, evident in the detailed lines. The image is monochrome, emphasizing contrast through sepia tones. In the background, buildings with distinct architectural features overlook the beach.

artworks.title: Les Bergeries, Soleil Couchant (Pastoral Scene, Setting Sun)
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral landscape with farm buildings, fencing, and grazing sheep. The etched style emphasizes texture and the color palette is dominated by sepia tones and browns. In the background, additional animals can be seen in expansive open land merging into a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Un Vieux Chantier à Rochester (The Old Dock-yard at Rochester)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint
artworks.description: The image shows a harbor with water and boats extending towards the distance. The horizon line is above the midpoint, with silhouettes of windmills visible against the skyline. The sky is covered with textured clouds. The brushstrokes are rough and sketchy, creating movement and texture. The color palette is monochromatic, with dark shades and lighter tones. Closest are indistinct, large objects that appear to be ropes or bundles, and a cask in the lower left corner. In the distance, figures and boats are seen on the water, merging into the shadows. The forest of sails from docked boats and distant buildings merge into the horizon, framing the windmills.

artworks.title: Le Port aux Mouettes (Port with Seagulls)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, aquatint, and sandpaper ground in black on beige laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a marine scene with a bustling harbor seen from a slightly elevated point. The view shows the water, ships, and horizon with a combination of fine etching and soft strokes providing detail and atmosphere. The water reflects the vessels in the foreground, while those in the distance appear as silhouettes. The artwork primarily uses shades of grey and black, creating a subdued mood. Additional sketches of ships and sails in a similar style are included on the sides of the main scene.

artworks.title: L'Orage (The Storm)
artworks.medium: drypoint and roulette with isolated areas of etching and possibly salt lift in black on Japanese paper
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral landscape with a low horizon, small hills, buildings, dramatic clouds, rocky terrain, and a monochromatic color palette. A cart led by oxen is in the foreground, and there are faint human figures on the left side of the image.

artworks.title: La Falaise: Baie de Saint-Malo (The Cliff: Saint-Malo Bay)
artworks.medium: heliogravure, etching, drypoint, roulette, and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a path leading to a body of water. Vegetation lines the path, and there are small human-made structures and boats in the distance. The sky is filled with detailed clouds, adding movement to the scene. The color scheme is brown and sepia tones.

artworks.title: La Chapelle Saint-Michel à l'Estre (The Chapel Saint-Michel at l'Estre)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint and roulette on light blue-green laid paper
artworks.description: This etching depicts a landscape with an elevated viewpoint. The horizon is high in the image, showing the sea meeting the sky with scattered clouds. The foreground shows a terrain with trees and bushes drawn with intricate patterns. In the distance, a promontory juts into the sea, and a castle-like structure is visible. The etching is primarily monochromatic with rich tonal variations. Various line techniques are used to create texture and depth in the landscape.

artworks.title: L'Hiver à Paris (Winter in Paris)
artworks.medium: etching, aqautint, spit-bite etching, soft-ground etching, drypoint, and scraping on light green laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a busy urban scene from an elevated viewpoint. The street is lined with tall, snow-covered buildings, and there is a sense of movement and activity in the etching-style artwork. The color palette is predominantly monochrome, giving the image a vintage look. People and animals are depicted navigating through the snowy street, alongside horse-drawn carriages. The buildings feature intricate details and various smaller scenes show interactions and activities within the city. The overall atmosphere is lively, capturing everyday urban life on a snowy day.

artworks.title: Westminster Bridge
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, roulette, aquatint, and spit-bite etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a busy urban scene in London. The view is from an elevated perspective, looking across a bustling street with Big Ben in the center. The sky takes up a significant portion of the scene. The artist uses fine strokes to create texture and movement, especially in the sky and the busy street below. The color palette is predominately sepia, giving the image a vintage look. Additional scenes and structures surround the main image, adding depth to the composition. The sky is textured to suggest movement and depth to the cityscape.

artworks.title: Les Esprits des Villes Mortes (Spirits from the Cities of the Dead)
artworks.medium: etching, roulette, drypoint, lift ground, aquatint, scraping and burnishing on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a cityscape viewed from an elevated perspective. The horizon separates the city structures from the sky. The city structures appear aged and worn. A group of figures in cloaks are observing the scene. In the distance, a gothic cityscape with towers and buildings is visible. The sky is filled with swirling clouds depicted in a dynamic style. The color palette is muted with sepia and gray tones, emphasizing a somber atmosphere. Light creates a subtle glow on the horizon.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Magi (Virgin in the Grotto)
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 39 x 28.2 cm (15 3/8 x 11 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows three main figures in a cave-like setting. One woman and two men are present, along with several cherubic angels in the background. The woman is seated, holding an infant who is standing or leaning against her lap. Her facial features are delicate, with a slightly downward gaze. She wears a draped garment with a head covering, and her hair is partially visible. The man to the left is bald on top with a beard, shown in profile, and appears to be kneeling or bending forward with clasped hands. The man to the right is standing in profile, supporting himself with a staff, wearing a long robe and a wide-brimmed hat, with a beard. Small angels with wings surround the woman and infant, their faces hidden. The scene is framed by cave walls and a rocky foreground, creating a sense of depth. The artwork features intricate linework, typical of an etching or engraving style.

artworks.title: Christ as Salvator Mundi
artworks.medium: woodcut
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing with one hand raised and the other holding an orb topped with a cross. The individual has a bearded face, long hair, and is wearing a robe with intricate patterns. A halo surrounds their head with radiating lines. The background is a plain surface with a decorative border.

artworks.title: Persian Sibyl
artworks.medium: engraving
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of a woman seated with her upper body slightly turned to the left. She holds a closed book in one hand and raises the other hand with a pointing gesture. She has detailed facial features with a serene expression, and wears an elaborate headdress that covers her head and shoulders. Her attire includes a gown with intricate patterns, long sleeves, a fitted bodice, and a full skirt. She wears jewelry on her neck and chest area. The background features inscriptions and decorative foliage.

artworks.title: Delphian Sibyl
artworks.medium: engraving
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of a seated woman in profile, looking to the left. Her head is slightly turned towards the viewer, revealing a detailed face with wavy hair cascading beneath a headpiece adorned with feathers. She wears intricate clothing, including richly patterned fabric and a cloak fastened with a decorative brooch. She holds a scroll in one hand with the inscription “SIBILLA DELFICHA,” surrounded by other scrolls or banners bearing inscriptions like “ABSQUE HUMANA CORRUPTIONE VIRGINE” and “NARCETVR PROPHETA.” The background features a rocky surface and additional text at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Cumaean Sibyl
artworks.medium: engraving
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body depiction of a seated woman positioned slightly to the left, with her head turned to the right. She has delicate facial features, with a serene expression and eyes gazing downward. Her hair is styled elaborately, pulled back with braids and a bun, and adorned with ribbons. The woman is wearing an intricately patterned dress with long sleeves and a square neckline, emphasizing ornate detailing. Draped fabric and decorations swirl around her. She holds an open book with visible text in one hand. The background is plain. Above her, a ribbon banner displays the word "SIBILLA CVMANA" in an elegant script.
